This was a couple of years ago, but it was so strange, and it makes me uncomfortable thinking about it because I can't think of a single explanation.

So one night, my friend invites me out to the bar. I drive my car to his house, and we take his truck to the bar. We hang out, have our drinks, and go to leave. He asks what time it is, so I check my phone. I put my phone back in my pocket as we get up to leave. We reach his truck, and I do the compulsory pat-down to make sure I have everything, and I don't have my phone. What the fuck? We walked out the door, 20ft across an empty parking lot. HOW did I lose it?? We scour the parking lot. We scour his truck. I check and re-check the bar, including the bathroom that I hadn't even used. My phone is nowhere to be found. After 15-20 minutes of looking, I admit defeat and we leave, me baffled as ever.

It gets weirder.

We get back to his house, and I search his truck one last time for my phone. Nothing. I get in my car and drive home, still trying to figure out wtf just happened. As I'm nearing my house, I hear something drop between my seat and the middle console. "What the hell? Could that have been my phone?" I get home. I jump out of my car and drop to my knees to reach one hand under the seat to feel for whatever dropped, with my other hand resting on the drivers seat. I can't feel anything, but as I contort to reach further back, something falls, seemingly, from the ceiling of my car, or maybe my headrest, tumbles down the seat, and lands on my hand.

It was my fucking phone.

Thank you! Everyone I tell just thinks I'm crazy. I can't wrap my head around it...I lost my phone while I didn't even have my car, how did it get in my car?! And how could it have remained balanced anywhere on the headrest or wherever, throughout my driving? It hurts my head.
